name: Plastic and cosmetic surgeon

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: New patient consult
services.story: The main story: a $250 new patient consult with Nadia. Nothing is taken at booking, and Alex pays at the front desk after the visit.

services.name: Post-op check
services.story: A free post-op check within 90 days of surgery. Nothing is taken, and there's nothing to pay.

services.name: Wound visit
services.story: A $140 wound visit. A card is saved for the $20 missed-visit fee, which the owner confirms before any charge, and Alex pays the visit at the front desk.

services.name: Rhinoplasty (surgery day)
services.story: A surgery day quoted at $4,800. A $1,000 deposit now counts toward it, and the $3,800 rest is paid at the surgery center's front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Omar (registered nurse) and Theo (nurse practitioner), who see patients at home under Nadia's orders

services.name: Post-op check at home
services.story: The main story: a $150 post-op check at Alex's home. A card is saved for the $89 missed-visit fee, and the card is charged when Omar texts DONE, after Alex says yes to the price.

services.name: Post-op check at home
services.story: The same visit billed to Alex's plan: nothing is taken, and the office bills the plan its own way.

services_shape: visit types with set lengths, each with a surgeon or nurse practitioner by name; consults and post-op checks are billed to the plan or paid by the patient; cosmetic procedures are self-pay; a surgery day is quoted in writing first, with a deposit toward it; anything added at the visit needs the patient's yes first
questions_before_times: which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a body part or a symptom typed into the AI
a health plan (its name only) or paying yourself
for a video visit: the state the patient will be in
join the list for a sooner time
safety_stop: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine, or after an anesthetic)
a leg that is swollen, painful and warm, or sudden chest pain or short breath after surgery
bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
a swallowed medicine, or too much of one
first_steps: A referral from the primary care doctor
A written quote for surgery and self-pay work
license: the owner's word: each surgeon, nurse practitioner and physician assistant holds their own license, and the practice its registration, where the state's form asks; Rosie never looks a license up
staff_skills: Nadia (plastic surgeon): consults, surgery days, cosmetic injections; Lucy (nurse practitioner): post-op checks, wound visits, and cosmetic injections where the state allows and the office lists them; Omar (registered nurse) and Theo (nurse practitioner): post-op home visits under Nadia's orders; the front desk: no clinical OKs
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the procedure, the plan, a referral, the reason, a body part, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the surgeon's name; at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
